title: Hidden reaction pathways inform additive engineering for perovskite LEDs
title_zh: 隐藏的反应路径指导钙钛灯外加剂工程
abstract: Perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) have emerged as a promising class of solution-processed light-emitting devices, combining high efficiency with facile fabrication1-5. Amino-acid-based molecular additives are widely used to regulate crystallization and suppress defects in perovskite thin films6-8, yet these molecules are chemically reactive in precursor solutions, in which their transformations and products remain poorly understood. Here we resolve and control the hidden solution-phase chemistry of a ubiquitous additive, 5-aminovaleric acid (5AVA), whose solution-phase reactivity has remained unclear6,9-15. We show that 5AVA undergoes competing in situ reactions during precursor preconditioning, yielding two chemically and functionally distinct products: a beneficial organoamidinium zwitterion and a detrimental Lewis-base lactam. By explaining this reaction dichotomy and establishing targeted reaction-pathway control, we selectively use the beneficial species. Direct synthesis and incorporation of the purified zwitterion decouple its intrinsic passivation function from confounding by-products, yielding perovskite films with a near-unity mean peak photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 97.2% and PeLEDs with a champion external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 37.1%, alongside a mean peak EQE of 32.8%. Finally, we demonstrate that this reaction-pathway control concept can be extended to further additive chemistries and emission colours, highlighting its potential as a chemistry-driven strategy for rational additive design in PeLEDs.
abstract_zh: 钙钛灯发光二极管（PeLED）作为一种有前景的溶液加工发光器件类别，结合了高效率与简便的制备工艺1-5. 氨基酸基分子外加剂广泛用于调控结晶并抑制钙钛膜中的缺陷6-8，然而这些分子在前驱体溶液中具有化学反应性，其转化产物尚不清楚。本研究揭示并控制了常用外加剂5-氨基戊酸（5AVA）在溶液相中的隐藏化学反应过程，该反应过程的细节此前尚不清楚6,9-15. 我们表明，在前驱体预处理过程中，5AVA 会发生竞争性的原位反应，生成两种化学性质和功能截然不同的产物：有益的有机 amidonium 杂瓣离子和有害的路易斯碱内酰胺。通过阐明这种反应二律背反并建立有针对性的反应路径控制，我们选择性地使用有益的物种。直接合成并掺入纯化的杂瓣离子，将其内在的表面被动化功能与干扰性副产物分离，从而得到峰值光致发光量子产率（PLQY）接近均值为 97.2% 的钙钛膜，以及峰值外量子效率（EQE）达 37.1% 的 PeLED，以及均值峰值 EQE 为 32.8%。最后，我们展示了这种反应路径控制概念可以进一步扩展到其他外加剂化学体系和发光颜色，突显了其作为钙钛灯外加剂设计的化学驱动策略的潜力。
